alternatives.name: INSTRUMENT_TYPED_FILL_MODELS
tradeoffs: Multiple simulator modes increase test surface; bar-only path remains for bar-declared research.

decision.summary: Crypto simulation extends the canonical deterministic simulator with venue-specific fees, funding, 24/7 sessions, and instrument-typed fill models. Broker paper trading is not canonical simulation.
decision.title: Crypto simulation extensions

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Proposed status does not authorize simulator implementation or live crypto trading.
